exampleEn: I took my friends for granted until I realized how much they mean to me.
exampleKo: 나는 내 친구들을 당연하게 여겼다가 그들이 나에게 얼마나 중요한지 깨달았다.
gameExamples: Many people take for granted the simple pleasures in life.
It's easy to take for granted the support of our family when things are going well.
We often take for granted the opportunities we have to learn and grow.
